schedule.intended_entry: same eligible session official regular open at 09:30 America/New_York
schedule.five_session_exit: official close of entry session plus four subsequent eligible XNYS sessions
schedule.utc_rule: derive UTC instants from the named IANA timezone and calendar for each session; never hard-code a fixed UTC offset
schedule.scheduler_rule: a future scheduler may use both 11:45 and 12:45 UTC cron candidates but must execute only when local time is 07:45 on an eligible XNYS session and when the cohort/session ID has not run
schedule.late_rule: completion or durable readiness after 08:40 is LATE; after 08:45 is also after-boundary; neither may be backdated
schedule.calendar_exceptions: no cohort on holidays or unscheduled closures; early-close entry sessions retain the official open and official early exit close when they are the fifth session
schedule.clock_rule: record wall-clock UTC and monotonic durations; if clock synchronization/uncertainty cannot establish ordering at deadline equality, disposition is UNKNOWN_CLOCK

universe.policy: one reviewed, versioned pilot manifest frozen before the first pilot session; at most 50 lexically ordered uppercase tickers already authorized by the existing subscription; unchanged for all 10 pilot sessions
universe.expected_member_rule: persist every frozen member before assembly starts; delisted, halted, missing, and failed members remain in reconciliation

snapshot.identity: snapshot_id is sha256 of canonical JSON containing contract version, cohort_session_id, ticker, typed identifier, feature vector hash, provenance hash, and attempt ID
snapshot.feature_vector_hash: sha256 of canonical, ordered feature-name/type/value/null representation

required_timestamps.source_event_at: when the source event occurred; not receipt or availability proof
required_timestamps.source_received_at: UTC instant this collector actually received or read the source, with evidence kind and source object ID
required_timestamps.feature_cutoff_at: maximum permitted information instant for this snapshot; fixed to snapshot_deadline_at
required_timestamps.assembly_started_at: UTC wall-clock immediately before feature assembly begins
required_timestamps.assembly_completed_at: UTC wall-clock after complete vector and provenance validation
required_timestamps.persistence_completed_at: UTC wall-clock after file flush, fsync, atomic rename, and directory fsync succeed
required_timestamps.ready_for_use_at: persistence_completed_at for local durable storage; later verified replica completion if the contract requires that replica
required_timestamps.scheduled_decision_at: fixed 08:45 America/New_York boundary converted to UTC

snapshot.hash_limitation: hashes prove byte/content identity only, not that a timestamp was historically true
snapshot.provenance: each feature family records definition/version, source object/content hash, event time, receipt evidence, availability status, freshness sessions, missingness, and error codes

selection_and_dispositions.selection: latest COMPLETE and durably ready snapshot with ready_for_use_at <= scheduled_decision_at and feature_cutoff_at <= snapshot_deadline_at; ties choose lexically greatest snapshot_id
selection_and_dispositions.duplicates: same content and identity is DUPLICATE_RETRY and retained as an attempt reference; never overwrites the accepted snapshot
selection_and_dispositions.corrections: append a new correction snapshot referencing supersedes_snapshot_id; it is eligible only for a later cohort unless independently ready by the original fixed boundary
selection_and_dispositions.reconciliation: exactly one final disposition per expected universe member; overlapping diagnostic reason codes are retained separately; counts sum to manifest member count

freshness.existing_supported_default: maximum 3 XNYS sessions for required completed-daily families, from DEFAULT_MAX_STALENESS_SESSIONS
freshness.new_limits: none; any family without a supported existing limit is UNKNOWN_FRESHNESS and not eligible

selection_and_dispositions.small_cohort_warning: min(5, eligible) equals the full eligible baseline when five or fewer qualify

storage.durability_gate: is_durable_runtime_configured() must be true and an operator must verify mounted-storage lifecycle, quota, backup/retrieval behavior, and access policy before pilot authorization; fallback data/ is ephemeral and blocks capture
storage.write_protocol: write attempt files and manifest to same-filesystem temporary paths; flush and fsync each; atomically os.replace; fsync directory; then append immutable completion record
storage.manifest: records ordered relative paths, bytes, SHA-256, schema/contract/code/config hashes, expected/reconciled counts, start/completion/ready times, and storage verification
storage.secrets: never persist API keys, auth headers, user tokens, private request bodies, or credentials
storage.access: existing service identity writes; pilot reviewer receives read-only retrieval; no public artifact
storage.retention: proposed minimum 180 days after the tenth pilot session, subject to the durability prerequisite; GitHub artifact URLs are optional transport copies and never durability proof
storage.retrieval_verification: within 24 hours of each session, read back manifest and all listed bytes from the durable root and verify hashes; failure is RETRIEVAL_UNVERIFIED and stops subsequent sessions
storage.failure_reporting: persist a compact failure manifest even when zero snapshots complete; never claim completeness after partial write

pilot_budget.provider_rule: consume only data already made available by the existing authorized collection/subscription path; a missing cache/object is recorded, not fetched
stop_conditions: durable runtime prerequisite is not verified
universe manifest is absent, changes, exceeds 50 members, or fails hash validation
a run would require an incremental provider request
runtime, storage, or assignment cap is reached
atomic persistence or 24-hour retrieval verification fails
calendar or clock ordering is unknown
secrets or forbidden outcome/prediction fields are detected

outcome_attachment.join_key: immutable snapshot_id plus cohort_session_id and typed security identity
outcome_attachment.entry: same-session official regular open strictly after scheduled_decision_at
outcome_attachment.exit: official close of the fifth eligible XNYS session, counting entry as session one
outcome_attachment.immutability: later outcomes never change universe membership, snapshot bytes, timestamps, disposition, or eligibility
prohibitions: no outcome retrieval under this contract
